lines.text: Once safely ashore, the travelers learned the island was Malta, and the islanders kindled a fire for them.
A scorpion fastened itself to Paul's hand, and the islanders said he was surely a murderer.
Paul shook the creature into the fire and suffered no ill effects, so the islanders said he was a god.
Publius hosted them for seven days, and Paul healed his father by praying and placing his hands on him.
The rest of the island's sick were cured, and the islanders supplied the travelers' needs as they sailed.
